_comment: Post-election mode. From post_election_from (America/Chicago date) the routine runs scripts/results.py and writes election updates instead of pre-election briefs. Pre-election ratings are frozen at the last raw snapshot before that date.

courtlistener._comment: scripts/courts.py. Token comes from a network secret for www.courtlistener.com on the cloud environment (preferred) or the environment variable named in token_env. Free tier: 5/min, 50/hr, 125/day; each run uses at most max_requests_per_run.
docket_queries: caseName:(election OR elections OR ballot OR ballots OR voter OR voters OR voting OR canvass OR canvassers OR "board of elections" OR "election commission")

alaska_state._comment: Alaska Division of Elections unofficial results, read daily by scripts/alaska.py. Update the URLs for a new election.
next_events: Nov. 18: deadline to receive by-mail ballots mailed from overseas addresses, final regional count of absentee and questioned ballots, and ranked-choice results (per the Division's results page)

not_called_by_ap._comment: Races the Wikipedia results table marks won but AP has not called. results.py counts them as uncalled and keeps the table's winner as context. Remove an entry once a news lead reports AP calling the race. Added 2026-11-24 from the AP tally (D 258, R 173, 4 undecided: Minnesota, Tennessee, two Louisiana runoffs) reported by Fox News and Anadolu.

HOU-TN-04.note: Rep. Scott DesJarlais (R) conceded to Victoria Broderick (D) on Nov. 16 after provisional ballots were counted (about 280 votes); AP's Nov. 22 tally still lists the Tennessee race as undecided

HOU-MN-01.note: the state certified Jake Johnson (D) ahead of Rep. Brad Finstad (R) by 324 votes on Nov. 19; Finstad requested a hand recount, and AP's Nov. 22 tally lists the Minnesota race as undecided
